name: GROWTH1-tab-left-out

name: GROWTH1-leaf-drifts

name: GROWTH1-captain-for-any-host

name: GROWTH1-due-off-the-points

name: GROWTH2-ready-misread
note: A path one Master Skills press away reads as far off - the guide hides the next step.

name: GROWTH2-never-misread
note: A path whose skill's group masteries are spent reads as within reach - the guide promises what cannot open.

name: GROWTH2-order-the-tables
old: .sort((a, b) => SPEC_STATES.indexOf(a.state) - SPEC_STATES.indexOf(b.state) || owed(a) - owed(b) || a.order - b.order);
note: The open path drowned in the table's order among twenty-nine others.

name: GROWTH2-nearest-last
note: Within reach, the farthest path first.

name: GROWTH2-ready-at-99
note: A skill at exactly 100 - the masterable value - read as still climbing.

name: GROWTH2-words-swapped
old: case 'mastered': return t('growth.spec.skill.mastered', '{skill}: mastered ({value})', { skill: s.name, value: s.value });
new: case 'mastered': return t('growth.spec.skill.mastered', '{skill}: {value} - ready to master in Master Skills', { skill: s.name, value: s.value });
note: A mastered skill told to be mastered again.

name: GROWTH2-empty-slot-read
old: if (!e || e.type < 0) continue;   // an empty slot of the maker's three
new: if (!e) continue;   // an empty slot of the maker's three
note: The maker's empty slots read as effects.

name: GROWTH2-forms-numbers
note: The technique's fatigue read off its cooldown.

name: GROWTH2-ask-the-other-family
old: pairText: pathSchoolsText, ask: (e, id) => pathChoiceRows(e, id), choose: choosePath,
new: pairText: pathSchoolsText, ask: (e, id) => martialChoiceRows(e, id), choose: choosePath,
note: An arcane path's Choose asks in the martial law's box.

name: GROWTH2-choice-not-the-law
old: pairText: pathSchoolsText, ask: (e, id) => pathChoiceRows(e, id), choose: choosePath,
new: pairText: pathSchoolsText, ask: (e, id) => pathChoiceRows(e, id), choose: (e, id) => { e.arcanePath = id; return { ok: true, text: '' }; },
note: The page writes the path itself, past the law's checks (a second path, a skill unmastered).

name: GROWTH3-face-left-up
